decisions.reason: Chick forebrain fate-map/prosomere model; abstract never mentions the roof, dorsal midline or paraphysis; only generic boundary relevance.
Generic lateral-ventricle choroid plexus (cortical hem-derived) in Mllt11 mutant mouse; no link to the paraphysis region.
Immunohistochemistry (PAX8+, no thyroid/mullerian/enteric differentiation) of 15 colloid cysts bears on histogenesis needed to weigh the paraphyseal hypothesis; paraphysis not tested.

Pediatric incidental colloid cyst case in a syndromic patient; no histogenesis or paraphyseal data.
Pinopsin knockout in Xenopus pineal physiology; pineal only, no paraphysis/parapineal-territory data.
Ectopic pituitary-stalk colloid cyst case report (endoderm-derived by assertion); clinical, no paraphyseal link.
Canine cerebellopontine-angle colloid cyst case; routine histopathology, no histogenesis analysis or paraphysis reference.
Lateral-ventricle colloid cyst regression case; calls to reconsider embryological origin but PubMed abstract never mentions paraphysis or analyses histogenesis (full abstract checked).
Forensic fatal colloid cyst case with standard histology; no paraphyseal or histogenesis discussion.
Cortical hem lineage tracing (Cajal-Retzius, hippocampal pyramidal neurons, ChP); generic hem paper never relating to the paraphysis region.
Neurosurgical management review of anterior third-ventricle tumours; clinical focus, no histogenesis/paraphysis content in abstract.
Infant haemorrhagic colloid cyst case report; only labels cyst neuroepithelial in passing.
Cortical hem beta-catenin / Cajal-Retzius specification in mouse; no paraphysis data or region link.
Skink embryonic staging table; only notes pineal timing, no paraphysis data.

Adult rainbow-trout (Salmo gairdneri) paraphysis cerebri: part of the pars impar telencephali; epithelium with zonulae occludentes, fenestrated sinusoids, CSF-regulation role proposed; bibliographic details missing.

Japanese single-case report with literature review of third-ventricle ependymal cyst; metadata only and title does not name paraphysis. Abstract/text needed to see whether paraphyseal origin is discussed.
Secondary study-aid page of unknown provenance with a single passing remark that the paraphysis is transient in embryos; no substantive data.
Title names paraphyseal cysts (Ependymal and Paraphyseal Cysts, Springer chapter); content unverified (metadata only).
Title names the paraphysis (Epiphyse und Paraphyse im Lebenscyclus der Anuren: anuran life-cycle study); content unverified (metadata only).
Radiology review explicitly states colloid cysts arise from abnormal folding of the neuroepithelial paraphysis; a stated paraphyseal-origin account, web snippet only.

Human embryology module on roof plate/third ventricle: states paraphysis diverticulum arises sometimes above foramina of Monro in humans, constant in lower vertebrates; locates the paraphysis in human ontogeny.
Lexicon definition of telencephalon impar; entry never mentions the paraphysis, tertiary source, not necessary for interpretation.
Lexicon entry on telencephalon impar/medial pallium; no mention of the paraphysis; tertiary source.
Cameron on pineal origin in Amphibia; title concerns the pineal only, metadata only, no evidence of paraphysis content.

Francotte, development of the epiphysis; title does not name the paraphysis, but Francotte is credited (Dexter 1902) with identifying it in a human embryo. Check Warren 1905/Dexter 1902 to see whether this paper carries the observation.
Needlefish Xenentodon cancila brain: diencephalic roof shows some indication (trace) of a paraphysis, parapineal absent; minor but original presence/absence datum for teleost distribution.

Herring (1927, year unconfirmed): describes dorsal sac and velum transversum giving rise to choroid plexuses and states paraphysis (glandular in lower vertebrates) is not represented in placental mammals; bears on anatomy/phylogeny of the paraphysis region.

Kuhlenbeck vol. 5 pt 1 (diencephalon and telencephalon); broad comparative treatise, metadata only, paraphysis coverage unconfirmed. Chapter/index check on telencephalon impar/paraphysis would resolve.
Minot's classic Acanthias pineal-region study, cited by Warren 1905 and Dexter 1902 for early paraphysis records; content secondhand, metadata only.
Roofe, histology of the paraphysis of Amblystoma: ependymal paraphyseal tubules opening by common mouth into third ventricle, venous sinusoid rete, mitochondria; year unconfirmed.
Spanish edition of Rouviere's anatomy textbook; catalogue record only, no paraphysis passage identified.

Studnicka, forebrain anatomy and development of craniotes (listed in Warren 1905); title does not name the paraphysis, metadata only. Warren 1905 citation context or the text would show whether it describes it.
Gecko paraphysis and epiphysis primordia as diencephalic roof evaginations (anterior and posterior borders); contrasts classical telencephalic placement (duplicate of R629, journal/year missing).
Wilder: dorsal sack defined as a diatelar pouch between epiphysis and paraphysis (large in Ceratodus, Polyodon); terminology/homology of the dorsal sac locating the paraphysis; year unconfirmed.
